transcript.content: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, it's nice to meet you too. Um... well, I guess I'm just having a little trouble with some parts of my job lately. I mean, I'm a health services manager, so I'm used to being busy, but... recently, whenever I have to do something that requires a lot of, you know, sustained mental effort—like sitting down and really focusing on monthly reports or planning out a big multi-site event—it just... it feels like I hit a wall. 

I don't want to make it sound like I'm not doing my job, because I am, but I just keep putting those kinds of tasks off. Even when I know they're really important. I just... I hope that makes sense? Is that the kind of thing you're asking about?
Have you had this kind of trouble staying focused on mentally demanding tasks since you were a child?

Well, yes, I suppose it's been going on for a while. I mean, I was a good kid, I promise I wasn't trying to be difficult or anything. My teachers actually always told my parents I was really bright, which was nice to hear... but, um, they did mention I was always daydreaming a bit. 

And I had this terrible habit of losing my worksheets. I'd just forget to turn in my homework, even if I had actually finished it. Honestly, unless my mother checked my backpack every single night, things just didn't make it to the teacher's desk. It's a little embarrassing to admit that now, at my age, but... yeah. Is that the sort of childhood stuff you're looking for? I want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Do you notice this same kind of difficulty focusing in other parts of your life outside of work?

Um... outside of work? Well, I mean, I don't think it's too bad. I try really hard to keep things together at home. I mean, my house isn't a disaster or anything, I promise. 

I guess... maybe sometimes I struggle a little bit with sitting through a really long movie or reading a dense book? Like, my mind might wander a little, but I think that happens to everyone, right? It's not like I'm completely ignoring my family or anything terrible like that. I really do try to be present. Does that... does that answer your question okay? I just don't want you to think I'm completely falling apart outside the office.
Do you often find yourself worrying a lot about different things?

Um, worrying? Not really, no. I mean, I care about my job and my family, obviously, so I want things to go well, but I wouldn't say I'm a worrier. I try to stay pretty positive, actually. I don't lay awake at night stressing about everything or anything like that. I just... I try to handle things as they come. Is that what you meant? I hope I'm not misunderstanding you.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Oh, no, definitely not. I mean... sure, it gets a little frustrating sometimes when I fall behind on things at the clinic, but I'm generally a pretty upbeat guy. I really enjoy my life and my family. I wouldn't say I feel down or depressed at all. 

I hope I haven't been sounding like I'm just sitting here complaining today! I really do try to keep a good attitude about everything, even when I get a little scattered. I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture. Does that help answer what you're looking for?
